resources.name: NiSi2 adamantane and fluorite crystal structures

access.notes: Adamantane: three interpenetrating fcc sublattices; Si at (0,0,0) and (1/4,1/4,1/4), Ni at (1/2,0,0); lattice constant 5.429 Å. Fluorite: standard CaF2 structure; lattice constant 5.395 Å. Positions and lattice constants are given in the paper.

resources.notes: Fully described in the paper; no external data file needed.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT package. Other similar codes (VASP, ABINIT) could be used, but an open-source equivalent is required.

resources.notes: The agent may choose any open-source DFT code capable of total-energy calculations.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials for Ni and Si

access.notes: Standard pseudopotential libraries (e.g., PSLibrary version 1.0.0, SSSP) provide tested pseudopotentials for Ni and Si.

resources.notes: The agent should select standard norm-conserving or ultrasoft pseudopotentials.
